title: U Mass - Non-esterified Fatty Acids
author: Jason Kim
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.x3hfqj6
materials: Gently shake the plate to ensure thorough mixing.

steps.title: Prepare Sample Wells
steps.instruction: Add serum or plasma samples to Plate A and dilute with buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add 5 μl (or 1~10 μl) of serum or plasma sample to a well of Plate A.
Add dilution buffer to each well to reach a total sample volume of 50 μl (e.g., 5 μl of sample in 50 μl total volume results in a 10x dilution).

steps.title: Prepare Standard Wells
steps.instruction: Add 50 μl of each standard to empty wells, using Plate B if necessary.

steps.title: Perform First Incubation
steps.instruction: Add FFA Reagent A to all wells and incubate.

substeps.instruction: Add 10.5 ml of reconstituted FFA Reagent A to one of the provided disposable trays.
Add 100 μl of FFA Reagent A to each well.
Place in a 37ºC incubator for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Perform Second Incubation
steps.instruction: Add FFA Reagent B to all wells and incubate.

substeps.instruction: Add 5.5 ml of reconstituted FFA Reagent B to the other provided disposable tray.
Add 50 μl of FFA Reagent B to each well.
Place in a 37ºC incubator for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Equilibrate and Clear Bubbles
steps.instruction: Allow the plate to reach room temperature and remove air bubbles.

substeps.instruction: Allow the plate to equilibrate to room temperature for 5 minutes.
Use a large gauge needle or clean pipet tip to pop any bubbles to avoid inaccurate absorbance readings.

steps.title: Measure Optical Density
steps.instruction: Measure the optical density of each well at 540 nm.
